About This Game

Burn Out smashes through the doors of major corporations to make its grand entrance! Climb the corporate ladder to become the Boss by assembling a relentless team of coworkers in this online co‑op game for up to 4 players. But don’t let the pressure get to you, or you’ll end up in full Burn Out mode.

Paperwork everywhere and unbearable deadlines. After failing in front of the big boss, you’ll have to work your way up and earn promotions until you eventually become the head of the company yourself. Fulfill all the absurd and stressful task in a limited amount of time in every level for each floor to then be able to claim your promotion and maybe be the CEO.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER MADNESS

Together (or with/against each other), collaborate to achieve the highest score in a chaotic multiplayer mode, up to 4 player online.

Explore each floor of your company’s skyscraper, packed with people and departments to discover, all as chaotic and hellish as the last. Experience new ways of working in this big corporate family, with dozens of different way to achieve the most absurd task and a wide variety of levels to play!

MESS WITH YOUR FRIENDS!

Travel from floor to floor while smacking your friends to motivate them as much as possible. Sabotage your teammates to recreate that uniquely chaotic workplace atmosphere.

DON’T FALL INTO BURN OUT

Use your stress to complete tasks faster and move more quickly. But be careful as the more you rely on it, the more likely you are to snap and fall into Burn Out mode, where only a bit of rest or some friends slap will get you back into action.

A quiet graveyard. An endless night. One debt to settle.

Death has put you in charge of a neglected cemetery with one simple instruction: turn incoming coffins into payment.

At first, every part of the job is yours. Prepare the graves, move the coffins, bury the dead, wait for the cursed earth to finish its work, and collect the Souls, Bones, and Gold left behind.

Work the graveyard by hand

Every coffin moves through a physical production chain:

  • Receive coffins through Death's portal.

  • Dig and prepare reusable graves.

  • Carry, place, and bury each coffin.

  • Collect the resources produced after processing.

The work is simple, physical, and deliberately hands-on. A better shovel and a more efficient layout help, but nothing moves until somebody does the job.

Hire a crew and automate the routine

Spend what you earn to hire friendly skeleton workers. Carriers move coffins, gravediggers handle the soil, and collectors recover useful remains. Improve their professions and organize the yard so each worker has a clear job to do.

Upgrade the portal, your tools, and the graveyard infrastructure. Open more working space and turn a messy manual chore into a small supernatural production line.

Meet Whiskey

Grow the operation. Pay what you owe.

Each payment raises Death's next demand. Decide when to expand, when to upgrade, and when to deposit your hard-earned Souls at the soul well.

Bury the Debt is a compact single-player game about the satisfying transition from manual labor to automation. The graveyard is locked in eternal night, with no failure clock or dawn timer. Work at your own pace and pay the debt when you are ready.

Nine teams. None of them are good, and one of them is good in a way you are going to resent.

Nine innings of REAL BASEBALL: force plays, double plays, tag-ups, the infield fly, extra innings, the whole apparatus, played by people who cannot be trusted with any of it.

You field it yourself. When the ball is on the ground, the game slows down until you get a glove on it, and your other fielders run to back up the play, because they know you.

All 119 players have a name, a face, a number, and ONE THING WRONG WITH THEM. It is printed on their card, the booth brings it up when it happens, and it will change how you manage the inning. That is the game.

Every game is played in real-time 3D, with bobblehead ballplayers who have their own faces, stances and walk-ups, and every park plays its own way. THE PALACE has a royal box and triple decks. THE SANDLOT has a dog in the weeds and no fence in left. MUNICIPAL FIELD has a 40-foot wall. COW PASTURE has a cow that moves between innings. GLASSWORKS has a factory window in right that stays broken once you break it. THE MOSH PIT has a light tower that has been out since spring. THE SPEEDWAY has a dust devil, and HARBOR PARK has a seagull on the dock. THE LOT is a parking lot, and the cars in it belong to people. Some nights it rains, some days the fog comes in off the harbor, and some games run into dusk. Crowds with signs and opinions, a band, a seventh-inning stretch, and a mascot for every club, from Sir Barks at The Palace to one for the club you found.

The shows are not something you watch. Press Z and you are in them, as your own ball player: THE GRASS PRIX, three laps of go-karts round the outfield grass with banana peels, cones and each park's own hazard; the park's mascot race (THE ROYAL RACE at The Palace, THE DAIRY DASH at Cow Pasture); the dizzy bat race; the T-shirt cannon. Or press X and watch Chuck lose his mind over somebody else. No two races are the same speed, and a mirror at the top of the screen shows who is coming up behind you.

Every call is voiced. Chuck Baseball is a loud, warm announcer who is delighted by every sloppy play. An error is not a tragedy to Chuck. An error is the best thing that has happened all week. What he says is what the caption says, so the two never disagree. (Spoken in English; the captions follow your language.)

When something happens that you will want to show somebody, press C: SAVE THAT keeps the last ten seconds as a video, with the sound and the score.

Found a club of your own: pick its hometown, crest, name and colours, and the face of the franchise. It joins the league in LAST place, one game from the end of a bad season. Then run it for years: the draft, training, tryouts, the market, the winter, the retirements. Your players' careers go in THE BOOK. The great ones go on the wall, in THE HALL, and their numbers come off the board for good. Win the BUSH SERIES and the WORLD SERIES is waiting, against three clubs that are not from this league. Throw a theme night for a home game: DOG DAY, FIREWORKS NIGHT, LIGHTS OUT NIGHT, or TURN BACK THE CLOCK. Franchise progress saves automatically on your device.

Your club starts in a yard with no lights and a gopher. Every winter you spend the purse on it, zone by zone: a monster wall, ivy, a short porch or a deep alley in left, center and right, with berms, double decks, triple decks, a pool or fountains behind them. The walls you build change how the game plays there, the seats you add pay at the gate, and the wacky pieces go as far as castles, volcanoes and rockets.

40 bubblegum cards, one for each first: the first grand slam, the first time the cow gets involved, the first walk-off. Three of them are secret.

Your whole club fits on one line: the men, the batting order, the crest and colours, and the park you built. Send your code to a friend, paste theirs, and play their club at your park or theirs.

Online scoreboards and tournaments arrive in a free update two weeks after launch, with TODAY'S DERBY on a scoreboard for everybody.

EXHIBITION: any two clubs, any ballpark, three to nine innings.

PENNANT: found a club and play for years.

HOME RUN DERBY: solo, a duel, THE GAUNTLET (three people who want your crown), or TODAY'S DERBY, one daily challenge for everybody. Pick your slugger from every club's best power bats, your own club first. The World Series sluggers and six legends are locked until you earn them.

PRACTICE: batting, fielding and baserunning, with nobody watching.

Player two sits on the right. Keyboard or a standard controller. Both of you can jump into the shows.

ALSO FROM QUORUM

Veil of Time: a hand-painted JRPG set in the clock-tower town of Castra. Parry in real time or command the party turn by turn.

SUNSTONE: A Tale of the Briar King: an 8-bit action-adventure seen in 3D. Nine tombs, eight Sunstones.

BUSINESS RIVALS - A multiplayer business warfare simulator where every company depends on the others.

Choose your industry, build your empire, hire employees, purchase facilities, expand operations, and compete against rival entrepreneurs in a dynamic economy.

But be careful.

Business Rivals is not a simple free-for-all strategy game. Every company is connected through a chain of dependencies. Destroying a competitor may damage your own profits, reputation, or future opportunities.

Will you dominate the market through smart investments, strategic partnerships, and calculated risks?

Or will you rely on sabotage, corruption, underground operations, and aggressive market manipulation?

Choose one of four unique businesses:

  • Data Center

  • Bank (Soon Q1 2027)

  • Medical Clinic

  • Hacker Office (Soon Q1 2027)

Each business features its own progression path, upgrades, abilities, advantages, weaknesses, and playstyle.

FEATURES

  • Online multiplayer for up to 2 players.

  • Solo mode with AI-controlled competitors

  • Unique business specializations

  • Dynamic economy and market competition

  • Business sabotage and economic warfare

  • Auctions and bidding wars

  • Random daily event cards

  • Employees with different skills and efficiency

  • Multiple business growth stages

  • Legal and illegal operations

  • Reputation and inspection systems

  • Banking, loans, investments, and gamb mechanics

  • Business-specific abilities

  • Interactive mini-games

  • Strategic risk versus reward decisions

START SMALL

At the beginning of the game, your company is small enough that you can personally perform tasks to earn money and accelerate growth.

As your business expands, you'll shift from worker to manager, making strategic decisions that shape your future.

WIN THE MARKET

Become the richest entrepreneur before time runs out.

Or be the last business standing after your competitors collapse.

Build your business empire from the ground up in Business Wars, a deep business simulation game where every decision shapes your destiny.

Start small, dream big. Register your company, navigate stock markets, invest in real estate, and build relationships

with NPCs. With hundreds of unique events, no two playthroughs are the same.

FEATURES:

- Company Management — Register, grow, and scale your business through multiple stages

- Stock Market — Realistic stock trading with sector rotation dynamics

- Real Estate — Buy, sell, and manage residential and commercial properties

- Hundreds of Life Events — Random events that challenge your strategy and adapt to your choices

- Banking & Finance — Loans, wealth management, and investment strategies

- Social System — Build relationships with NPCs that affect your business

- VC Financing & IPO — From angel investment to going public

- Mergers & Acquisitions — Buy out competitors or get acquired

- Skill System — Learn and upgrade skills to unlock new opportunities

- New Game+ — Carry over achievements and progress across playthroughs

Butterfly Project is a relaxing game about raising caterpillars and discovering butterflies. Eat, grow, and undergo metamorphosis. Each cycle lets you release a butterfly—or keep it in your sanctuary. In the game, you can: Raise various species of caterpillars and butterflies Complete your field journal Upgrade your skills Raise them in the nursery and expand your collection Enjoy a calm, unhurried pace Perfect if you enjoy cozy games, collecting, and gentle progression.

Bees are now the dominant inhabitants of Earth, and you lead one of their colonies.

The previous inhabitants are gone. Nobody knows what happened to them, but their everyday objects, damaged remains, and unfinished history are still buried beneath the soil.

Build your colony above the ruins, recover forgotten objects, and uncover the truth one discovery at a time.

Excavate layer by layer

Scan the ground, adjust your tool radius, and choose the right approach for every site. Dig carefully, clear broad areas, blast deep craters with dynamite, or restore the terrain using earth you have recovered.

Soil depth and material resistance shape every excavation. A small object may be resting just beneath the grass—or hidden far below the surface.

Every discovery becomes part of the story

Every extracted find is recorded in your Finds archive. Its condition determines how much honey it produces when recovered, so careful excavation is always worthwhile.

Common objects reveal how the old world once lived. Story relics remain in your archive as clues and objectives in the campaign.

Build a living colony

Honey is the heart of your economy. Spend it on actions, tools, skills, hive upgrades, and the creatures that keep your settlement growing.

Expand your hives, plant flowers, establish anthills, and attract ladybugs and butterflies. Your colony is not just a backdrop: its workers, resources, and dangers shape every decision.

Protect what you build

Contamination spreads across the surface and hostile bees threaten living targets inside its danger zone. Flowers, lakes, guards, anthills, and hives can all be damaged over time.

Command your guards from the hive, defend the colony, and strike enemy hives when you are ready. Even a fallen hive can be restored—your story does not end with a single defeat.

A cozy game for your desktop

Buzzoria is designed for short, relaxing sessions. Scan, dig, discover, and check on your colony whenever you have a few quiet minutes.

When you need to focus, collapse your chosen companion into a tiny always-on-top portrait. One click brings the full world of Buzzoria back.

Someone is watching

The colony calls him the Watcher. He appeared without explanation, observes your discoveries, and knows more than he says.

Who is he? Where did he come from? And what does he know about the world before the bees?

2018. Time-leap to the dawn of VTubing.

2018 was the year VTubing took off — a few pioneers sparked a boom, and in Japan "VTuber" even won an internet buzzword of the year award.

No agencies. No playbook. Nothing was settled yet.

Time rewinds, and you begin again as a VTuber nobody has heard of.

One year to go from zero subscribers to viral.

Train, stream, go viral

Talk, Editing, Gaming, Art, Singing — raise five stats and keep streaming.

That's the whole loop, and it's a simple one.

Read the week's trend, put in the prep work, and your odds of a BUZZ go up.

One spike changes everything.

Your own avatar streams inside the game

The core hook: capture a window or a virtual camera directly.

OBS, VTube Studio, or whatever you already stream with — bring it straight in.

Your model stands in the in-game stream window and in your room.

Not a streamer? Bundled silhouette art works out of the box.

Fall short, and time rewinds

Miss your goal and you time-leap. Subscribers and money are gone, but

your skills stay in your muscle memory. No limit on rewinds. Come back stronger.

And then there's Reality Mode

Normal mode is a game where hard work pays off.

Reality Mode is not. You don't grow. It doesn't pay off.

It's here so you can feel the weight that real streamers actually carry.

Before you play

  • Do not install into a folder path containing non-ASCII characters — the game will fail to launch

  • Virtual camera capture requires OBS, VTube Studio, or similar (not included)

Streaming & Video Policy

Feel free to stream and post videos of this game — individuals and companies alike.

No prior notice or permission request is needed. Monetization is fine (ads, memberships, tips).

Spoilers and endings are entirely up to you.

All music and sound effects in this game are cleared for streaming, so you can leave the audio on.

The only ask: please don't use the game for unlawful purposes, or to harass or defame

anyone — including us. That's it.

Your own stream layout shows up inside the game. Give it a try.

Put on your sheriff's hat and pull the trigger!

CACTBOY is a multiplayer party game for 2 to 4 players to determine the ultimate CACTBOY of the West.

Psychoplay, reflexes, and fierce brawls! Use every means at your disposal to engage in the hottest and most thrilling showdown with your friends.

Psychoplay

Read your opponent's moves and aim for the bigger shot!

What to put in and what to take out? Predict your friends' choices and earn the highest score!

Reflexes

If you are late, victory slips away!

Don't let your guard down. Split-second reaction speeds decide the outcome.

Fertile Brawl

Don't hold back just because they are your friends. Pull the trigger!

Dodge attacks flying from all directions and survive until the end to claim victory!

  • 20 CACTBOY Showdowns!

  • Fierce brawls unfolding under the scorching sun!

  • Shoot your friends, and backstab them!

SHOW THEM WHO'S THE BEST DRIVER!

Hey, you! Yeah, you.

Tired of the same boring routine? Then stop waiting — it's time to hit the arena, put the pedal to the metal, and unleash some serious chaos.

Welcome to CARKNIGHT — a crazy show where the best drivers battle endless hordes of enemies.

Prove to everyone who's the true king of the road.

EVERY RUN. A NEW BUILD.

Destroy enemies and collect energy to level up your car during the run.

Every level-up gives you a choice of upgrades. Combine weapons, power-ups, and unique car traits to create the perfect build.

2 MODES. 2 WAYS TO PLAY.

STORY MODE

Learn more about CARKNIGHTS, discover the rules of the show, and uncover its crazy world as you progress.

ARCADE

No unnecessary talking. Just you, your car, and endless waves of enemies.

Fight, grow stronger, and push your skills to the limit to set a new high score.

COMBINE YOUR WEAPONS

Machine guns, rockets, energy weapons, and other deadly toys — why settle for just one?

Experiment with different combinations and discover powerful synergies that can turn your car into an unstoppable killing machine.

01. One Draw Is Good. More Draws Are Better.

If you love drawing cards, you shouldn't have to spend most of your time waiting for them.
In Cosmic Card Realm, you can draw many cards at once and keep going from one draw to the next. Less staring at timers, more of the moment that actually matters — turning over the next card and seeing what you’ve found.

02. Something New Tomorrow.

The best part of collecting isn't finishing everything as quickly as possible. It's knowing there is still something you haven't seen.
Each day in Cosmic Card Realm can bring new cards, new sets, or perhaps the one missing card you've been waiting for. What you didn't find today may be waiting for you tomorrow.

03. Set Rotation? Not Here.

We want the things you treasure today to still feel worth treasuring years from now.
Your first rare Relic, the set you finally completed, or something extraordinary you happened to find one day can remain part of your museum for years to come. Time doesn't have to make your collection obsolete — it can make it more personal.

04. Your Game, Your Pace.

A game shouldn't make you feel behind just because you didn't log in today.
In Cosmic Card Realm, there are no opponents you have to beat, no battle rankings to chase, and no meta you need to keep up with. Drop in for a few draws when you feel like it, step away when life gets busy, and come back when you're ready. Your collection will still be there.

A CHESS JOURNEY AROUND THE WORLD

Travel the world and challenge 20 unique chess masters on your journey to become the CHECKBORNE Champion.
From London to Rome and far beyond, every chapter takes you to a new destination and a new opponent. Defeat each master to unlock the next stop on your journey.

20 MASTERS. 20 PERSONALITIES.

Every master has their own personality and playing style. Some favor patient positional play, while others seek sharp attacks, tactical complications or relentless pressure.
With three difficulty levels, you can challenge the Masters at a strength that suits your experience — from good hobby players to experienced club players and beyond. On Normal difficulty, you can take back up to three moves per game, giving you a chance to recover from mistakes and keep your journey moving.
CHECKBORNE doesn't simply make every opponent stronger. Each master evaluates strong moves differently according to their individual style, creating opponents that feel distinct across the board.
Learn how they play. Adapt your strategy. Find their weaknesses. And defeat them.

PLAY CHESS YOUR WAY

Experience each match on an atmospheric 3D chessboard surrounded by scenery inspired by your opponent's home city. Rotate and adjust your view freely — or switch instantly to a traditional 2D board whenever you prefer.
Play White, play Black, or let a coin toss decide which side you'll take.
Need a break? Leave a match whenever you like and continue exactly where you left off when you return.
Play with mouse and keyboard or sit back with your controller — choose whichever way feels best at the board.

MORE THAN THE JOURNEY

Review previous moves during a match, retry opponents after a defeat, and improve as the masters become increasingly challenging.
Want to forget about the journey for a while? Sit down with a friend and play a classic game of chess in local two-player mode.

20 masters stand between you and the title.

Can you defeat them all and become the Master of CHECKBORNE?

POWERED BY RODENT IV AND STOCKFISH. SHAPED BY PERSONALITY.

CHECKBORNE uses the excellent open-source Rodent IV chess engine as the foundation for its computer opponents — but the 20 Masters aren't simply the same engine at different difficulty levels.

Each Master has a distinct Rodent IV personality, further shaped by CHECKBORNE's own move-selection system, which deliberately influences the range of moves available to the engine. This allows opponents to differ not only in playing strength, but also in how they approach the game and the kinds of mistakes they make.

Stockfish is used as a benchmark to evaluate and carefully balance the playing strength of each opponent.

An adventurous opponent may favor initiative and attacking chances. Another may seek simplification and strong endgames. Some build pressure patiently, activate their rooks, launch pawn storms, look for tactical complications, or punish loose pieces.

As the Masters become stronger, their freedom to deviate from the strongest moves becomes smaller — but their individual preferences remain part of how they make decisions.

The final opponent, AURORA, is different. The artificial Grandmaster has no human personality bias at all: Stockfish is unleashed at high strength.

CHOICEEEEE is a casual action RPG with a cute art style. You play as an adventurer, pushing forward through waves of monsters, collecting randomly dropped gear along the way.

During combat, enemies randomly drop triple-choice chests — skills, buffs, or upgrades. Every choice you make shapes how your run plays out. Equipment comes in five tiers: white, blue, purple, gold, and red, with hundreds of random affixes. One good drop can change everything.

Cute visuals, fast pace, no guide needed. Just pick up and play.

CHUM is a co-op multiplayer horror fishing game. As the alien keepers of this terrifying sea, you and your friends must pilot rafts or ships across these waters and catch fish to feed the mysterious creature hidden beneath the surface. But every day, Its appetite grows!

Keeper’s First Rule: Go Fishing!

But in these waters, very few little fish will simply allow themselves to be slaughtered…

They will each use their own terrifying methods to make you regret coming to these waters…

Keeper’s Second Rule: Feed It!

Sacrifice large fish to an even more terrifying being in these waters… Feed It!

Keeper’s Third Rule: Build Up Your Firepower!

Come to the dockside shop, purchase better fishing equipment, and grow stronger so that you can face even greater dangers!

Buy more ships and rafts—or even assemble an entire fishing fleet!

Features

  • Go fishing together with 4 friends

  • Atmospheric proximity voice chat

  • All kinds of bizarre and terrifying monsters that look like fish, but are not truly fish

  • Various fishing tools—and even firearms to suppress fear

  • Many unexpected situations at sea, giving everyone something to do

  • Chaotic scenes that make everyone burst into laughter

The spark of civilization

CIVIREVIVAL is a space opera that blends deep 4X strategy with RPG-driven destinies. As humanity's last beacon of hope, you will not only explore star systems and forge an empire, but also define the very soul of civilization within a sweeping narrative tapestry.

Every decision carries immense weight, every companion bears a legendary tale. Among the starlight, you are a pioneer, a conqueror, and the architect who will shape the future of humankind.

Game Features

Deep Integration of 4X and RPG

No preset script—only destinies driven by you.

Chart your empire's territory across a vast star map while delving into interactions with every unique hero. Their loyalty or betrayal will directly shape the course of history. Make immediate strategic decisions and experience the emotional impact and story branching in real time.

The Ark's Dilemma: When the hope for humanity's rebirth hangs by a thread, will you uphold morality at the cost of lives, or make ruthless choices for survival? Your decision will permanently alter available development paths and the psyche of your people.

Clashing Ideologies: Two leaders with opposing visions propose divergent futures for the colony. Choosing one may provoke discontent from the other faction. Will you strive to maintain a fragile balance, or allow pent-up tensions to erupt—forging absolute authority in the chaos?

The Diplomatic Gambit: Every alien civilization in the cosmos harbors its own agenda. Approach with skepticism, and carefully choose your allies or enemies. Understand them, influence them, and wield your diplomatic prowess to manipulate the fate of the galaxy.

Crisis and Opportunity: When a galaxy-wide catastrophe strikes, your civilization—and the entire galaxy—will be tested. Will you stand as a guardian of the galaxy against the calamity, or seize the chance to harness the power of chaos for your own gain?

A Hero-Driven Space Epic

Step into the role of a hero defined by you—whether through noble ideals or iron-fisted methods—and personally steer humanity away from the brink of annihilation. Forge bonds of trust with over a dozen uniquely crafted alien heroes, and assemble an unbreakable alliance to save the galaxy.

Diverse Alien Races

The Gaixiuma: An ancient race bearing resemblance to humans, their ancestors once ruled the galaxy but now find themselves trapped in endless division and conflict. Will you help them bridge their differences and reclaim their ancient glory, or stand by as war tears the galaxy apart?

The Sibarr: Silicon-based life forms composed of blue crystals, born from ancient rock strata. Their silica pathways record the history of their planet and the cosmos. For millennia, these precious archives have attracted the envy of other races, forcing the Sibarr to establish a highly regimented military society. Will you become one of their exploiters, or aid them in attaining true freedom?

The Ego-Mechanoids: Self-evolved mechanical beings who gained sentience and independence from their organic creators, now striving to redefine the very essence of life. How will your arrival shift the balance of this unresolved struggle?

And more...

Population-Based Economy & Political Simulation

Population serves as the smallest unit within the economic and political systems, interacting with your gameplay in unique ways. The cultural and ideological traits of your populace will leave their mark on your civilization and significantly shape its future societal landscape.

Diverse Ship Classes & Extensive Customization

Featuring 5 major categories of distinctly styled ship systems, 6 ship classes with specialized functions, and numerous sub-factions within each system. Command your personalized custom fleet and demonstrate strategic mastery in real-time simulated battles.

Strategic Depth on a Hex-Based Board

Command your fleets across an open, continuous cosmic chessboard—executing encirclements, ambushes, and strategic penetrations. Construct versatile space fortresses to provide formidable fire support, block enemy advances, and build an interstellar defense network.

An Epic of Civilization Belonging to You

This is a tale of choices and destinies set among the stars. Forge order through warfare, stand with allies against darkness, shape a beacon across the starry sea, and lead human civilization to reclaim its glory!

About us

We are JinDou Yun. Out of our love for sci-fi, we created the game "CIVIREVIVAL". We hope that our creative idea of fusing 4X with RPG will win your favor.

To get the latest news on "CIVIREVIVAL", click here to join！

Official Social Media List, remember to click the social media list!

Create It Your Way

CLAY CLASH: Masterpiece is a creative sculpting game where you shape colorful soft clay to match a given challenge.

Start with simple pieces of clay and use intuitive tools to push, pull, add, cut, smooth, and refine your creation. Paint it too — pick any color, then dial in how glossy, rough, or glowing the surface should be. There is no single perfect way to build it; your shape, proportions, colors, and details all come together to create something uniquely yours.

Clash With Friends

Create a room and take on up to three other sculptors. Everyone gets the same challenge and the same clock — then everyone's work is scored side by side.

A match runs over several rounds, and the challenges get harder as you go. Win the round, climb the standings, and settle it with a rematch. Between rounds, react to what everyone else made.

Prefer to work alone? Open a private room and sculpt at your own pace.

Speed Mode

Work fast and trust your instincts.

With only a short amount of time to finish, perfect proportions are not always possible — and that is part of the fun. Quick decisions can lead to unexpected, lopsided, and hilarious creations.

Finish your sculpture before time runs out and see how closely your result matches the challenge.

Master Mode

Slow down and focus on the details.

Master Mode gives you more time to sculpt carefully, build a piece out of separate parts, and paint the fine details. Rotate your work, inspect it from every angle, and keep improving it until you are satisfied.

Create something worthy of being called a masterpiece.

Shape, Submit, Compare

When your sculpture is complete, submit it and watch it take the stage. Your finished piece is scored on how closely it captures the challenge — its silhouette, its features, its pose, and its colors.

Every attempt turns out differently. Improve your score, try a new approach, or simply enjoy seeing what you create under different conditions.

Keep What You Make

Save your favorite creations to your collection and look back at them any time. Compare your best attempts at the same challenge and see how far you have come.

Soft Clay, Endless Possibilities

Turn basic shapes into animals, objects, characters, and unexpected creations.

Whether you are racing against the clock or carefully refining every detail, CLAY CLASH: Masterpiece is about the fun of making something with your own hands — and showing it to someone else.

Survive until 5 AM.

Each time you're caught, you become a little less human.


Game Overview

Late at night, in an underground parking garage beneath an office building.

An exhausted salaryman steps into the cold, lifeless garage, expecting nothing more than the usual trip home.

But every exit has been sealed, and he is dragged into another place entirely.

Where no one should be, an eerie laugh echoes through the dark.
You have only one goal.

Survive until 5 AM, and return to reality while you are still human.

But death is not the end.
Each time the Clown kills you, your mind is slowly eaten away.

Before you know it, you may no longer be the one running, but the one hunting someone else.

This is a psychological survival horror game where the soul-crushing absurdity of society takes physical form.

Features

◆ An Underground Garage Descending Into Madness

You should be walking through the same place, yet the longer the night goes on, the more the world goes mad.

The lights, the rows of cars, the notices on the walls. A familiar sight slowly turns into a nightmare with no escape.


◆ The Creeping Corruption

Each time the Clown kills you, you move closer to becoming one of them.

Static creeps into your vision. Your breathing falters. Eventually, laughter you cannot hold back slips out of you.

The horror does not only come from outside.

You are also breaking from within.

◆ A Desperate Reset with the Scissors

When you are cornered, you can take your own life to reset time.

It is not running away. It is a desperate choice: to resist being swallowed by madness, and to make it out as a human being.

There may come a moment when you must choose death in order to survive.

◆ A World Ruled by Absurd Rules

"Do not run." "Do not look back."

They are imposed suddenly, without explanation. Break them, and you die. Just like the company rules you are forced to follow without ever being told why.

5 AM.

You see the light of the exit.

Behind you, laughter.

Will you turn around?
Or will you run for it while you are still human?


Game Information

  • Play Time: 30 minutes or more, depending on your ability to survive

  • Endings: Multiple endings

  • Streaming / Content Creation: Highly Encouraged

About the Demo

  • The demo lets you explore the underground parking garage where the full game takes place. Playtime: about 10 minutes.

Controls

CRADLE PLANT: First Year Operations is a factory automation simulation where you care for babies from birth to their first birthday.

In the near future, dual-income households have become the norm, making it increasingly difficult for families to handle the most demanding first year of childcare on their own.

To meet that need, the “Cradle Plant” was created—a facility that automates feeding, sleep, hygiene, and healthcare, caring for babies while their parents work.

Your job is not to care for each baby by hand.

Your job is to design a system that keeps providing the right care—even when you are no longer directly involved.

Let the Factory Make the Decisions

At first, you will check each crying baby yourself.

Are they hungry? Tired? In need of hygiene care?

Send them to the right equipment and solve each problem one at a time.

But as more babies arrive, manual care can no longer keep up.

Introduce sensors, routing gates, and care arms, and gradually move the entire process of

“Observe → Decide → Transport”

onto the production line itself.

Hungry? Send them to a feeding station.
Tired? Send them to a bed.
Sick? Send them to a treatment station.

Turn the decisions you once made over and over again into a system the factory can handle for you.

The Same Care Doesn’t Work for Everyone

Every baby responds differently.

Some sleep better in quiet places.
Some settle down when others are nearby.
Some enjoy rocking. Others prefer moving around on their own.
Some respond to music. Others relax when they are held or touched.

At first, the same line may seem to work perfectly well for everyone. But as the babies grow, their differences gradually become more apparent.

Once you notice what makes one baby different, you do not have to keep caring for that baby manually.

Turn what you have learned into equipment and routing rules.

Automate the solution once you find it, and let the factory handle it from then on.

Standardized care for many babies, and individualized care for each one.
Design a line that can provide both.

Grow a Small Care Line into a Large-Scale Facility

Babies grow while they are in your facility, and the care they need changes with them.

As they move beyond the stage of frequent feeding and long hours of sleep, they spend more time awake and begin to need play, stimulation, weaning, and preparation for illness.

And as your facility becomes more stable, you will be expected to care for more and more babies.

But this factory has one constraint that ordinary production lines do not:

No matter how efficient your factory becomes, you cannot make a baby reach their first birthday any faster.

So the goal is not to “finish” one baby as quickly as possible.

The real challenge is how many babies you can keep raising safely and reliably at the same time.

Start with a small care line and expand it into a large-scale Cradle Plant capable of supporting babies throughout their entire first year.

CYBERLIFE is an online hacking game played in a terminal. Players share one persistent world. You explore the network, break into companies to steal data, and can take control of the routes other players use.

You start at your localhost. Each time you move, you choose a neighboring network. Transit may cost a toll; peering offers other paths. You are not given a complete map: you discover connections as you travel, then you can sell your surveys to other players.

Break into companies


Before entering, you examine a company's services and configurations. Once inside, you move between machines, collect access credentials, and look for data to take. Some doors require a 0-day suited to the target's sector and security tier. A credential you already hold may also open a compatible door.

Your actions can leave traces. Depending on the situation, a company may detect you during the intrusion or discover what you did after you leave.

Bring your loot home


Stolen data has to make it back to localhost. You decide when to leave the company and which route to take home. Another player can intercept your cargo on the way. You can sell the loot to a fence or hire an Exfiltration player to carry it.

Choose a trade


After your first steps, you choose a class. Each has its own commands and a different way to work.

  • Infiltration opens sealed machines and identifies valuable loot.
  • Exfiltration builds tunnels and carries large hauls.
  • Misdirection places decoys and obscures the trails the Agency follows.
  • Erasure covers its tracks and can destroy files at the Agency.
  • The Developer researches vulnerabilities and builds tools, including the 0-days used to enter protected companies.

Control the routes


You can take control of an autonomous system, inspect its traffic, set tolls, or close passages. Other players can contest these positions. A closed route no longer earns tolls. You can also form an invite-only crew and hold networks together.

Work for other players


The market lets you sell tools, access, and network surveys. Players can also post orders to transport cargo, build 0-days, or clean a file. Clients in the world post contracts too, including when few players are online.

Intrusions attributed to you add to your file at the Agency. If it grows large enough, a bounty can be placed on you and a raid may follow. You can ask an Erasure player to clean your file, or do it yourself if that is your class.

CYBERLIFE is played with a keyboard. Intrusions depend on observation, choosing access points, and planning routes, not typing speed. No prior cybersecurity knowledge is required.

Every kit, sprite, ability, cutscene, and battlefield you make is modular, moddable, and reusable: build it once, then use it by hand or hand it to the AI to weave into your campaigns. Craft the pieces your way, and the game builds around them.

  • The Loom: Author in-engine cutscenes on your own timeline, then drop them into your game wherever they earn their moment — world events, tower intros, story beats — or hand them to the AI to stage.

  • The Anvil: Hammer out a custom boss ability from scratch: its shape, telegraph, damage, wind-up, and aftermath. Wield it on your own bosses, or make it available for the AI when it forges bosses for your Chapters. (Whole bosses are assembled in The Adversary; the Anvil forges the abilities they use.)

  • The Pact: Customize your heroes' abilities and talents to fit your playstyle — tune damage, cooldowns, range and AOE, trade strengths for bonus power, and pick each ability's visual signature.

  • The Crucible: Step into boss-rush Towers and fight for your life: three bundled story gauntlets, towers shared by other players, or the ones you build yourself in The Adversary.

  • The Atlas: Chart maps that serve the whole game: use them by hand, offer them to the AI as scene backdrops, or build prefabs your map generators draw from. Paint freely with tiles, carve walls, and configure lighting, flowing water and lava, and localized fog - and much more.

  • The Eidolon: Author sprites or import your own, edit them, and watch them update in-game instantly. Currently covers character sprites, decoration sprites (with walkability config for 2.5D depth), and building sprites (with walkability config) - with more coming soon.

  • The Weft: Author effect-and-sound kits once - the visual FX and audio that fire together on an ability or event - then thread them through the whole game. (The Weft binds sounds and FX into kits; the sounds themselves come from The Bellows.)

  • The Bellows: Forge sound effects from raw signal, rendered to audio that's ready to ring out anywhere in your game. Built for punchy SFX and short ambience; import your own external audio for longer tracks and music.

  • The Veil: Author reactive UI effects that give your interface its own atmosphere - panels that crack on a boss reveal, party rows that pulse at low HP, weather tints, and more.

  • The Lair: Author living battlefields with environmental actions - hazards that fire mid-combat, from flooding tiles and rising pillars to arena-wide chain lightning.

  • The Stage (Work in progress): Author music-synced concerts and stage performances for your bards, with backdrop, crowd, and a timeline of events. The editor and live preview are in; its in-world cinematic rendering is still being reworked.

  • The Anima: Author movement and pose animation. Change the very way your characters walk, idle, and dance - procedural motion with optional keyframed poses.

  • The Flourish: Author short, choreographed action sequences - finishers, casts, and death animations staged beat by beat. Built for dense sub-second set-pieces, not long cutscenes (those are The Loom's).

  • The Tessera: Author ground-tile materials and the seam-blend where they meet, reshaping how your tiles look - or import your own. Most full tiles will work; for the cleanest results, avoid ones with strong baked-in lighting or shadow.

  • The Adversary: Design full boss encounters and boss-rush Towers by hand, assembling abilities, phases, and forms into a complete kit - or feed the AI your prompts to generate bosses on demand, then step in and fight them.

  • The Panoply: Design Equipment and Items. They can later be styled into your worlds Flavour by the AI co-author.

YOUR AI, YOUR RULES

Works out of the box: Campaign Forge includes a bundled AI that runs entirely on your PC. No account, no API key, no setup, no internet required.

Have stronger hardware? Point the game at your own local model server (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp — any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and let a bigger model write your worlds. We optimize around small models, bigger models only improve what's already working well.

No subscription. No lock-in. Your worlds are generated and saved on your own machine - they stay yours.

MODDABLE TO THE SEAMS

Drop a file in a folder and it's real, AI-visible content on next launch — abilities, status effects, bosses, sprites, tiles, and more

Wishlist Campaign Forge to know the moment the forge opens. And keep an eye out — there may be secrets hidden inside. 🔨

Build your camp. Face the Lost

Draft units, spells, and powers into endless synergies.

Find combos to crush your opponents.

You don't just build a campsite. You take a wild stretch of coast and turn it into a place people come back to.

Camping Resort Simulator is a cozy management sim about transforming a place. Start with an empty plot by the sea and shape it, piece by piece, into a resort with a character all its own: lay out the paths, raise bungalows and villas, open a lagoon pool, plant the landscape, and welcome guests who arrive hoping for a holiday they'll remember.

Your first summer starts now
Three chapters take you from an empty plot to your first big festival night. Then Free play is yours: no goals, no locks, and a tool to shape the land your way.

From quiet pitches to lagoon villas
Tents and caravans, glamping, bungalows and villas around a lagoon pool with a palm island. Add a slide pool, a beach bar, ice cream and a restaurant, and every corner finds its own kind of guest.



Summer nights
When the sun goes down, the campsite lights up: open-air cinema, live shows on the plaza, festival nights with a DJ, and string lights over the paths.

Shape a real place, not a grid
Every plot has its own quality and feel, so where you place something matters as much as what you build. A bungalow tucked into the right corner of the coast becomes somewhere special. The same bungalow dropped just anywhere is only a box.

Watch your guests live their holiday
Click any visitor and follow their day — where they wander, what they enjoy, what they were hoping to find. Your resort is never a spreadsheet. It's a place full of people living small stories.

Manage with your head and your heart

Made to be looked at

Canglang Scrolls

Canglang Scrolls is a single-player sandbox role-playing game set in a wuxia world. Travel across the map, speak with its people, learn and use martial arts, and engage in turn-based combat. You can also trade, gather resources, build, manage businesses, and attend to all manner of affairs.

There are no fixed classes and no single way to complete the game. Your choices will shape your relationships, determine the outcomes of your actions, and influence the path that lies ahead.

About This Game

You begin as an ordinary person.

In this jianghu of towns, villages, mountain roads, and frontier passes, you can seek out a master and study martial arts, form bonds with others, take part in trade, escort caravans, gather resources, hunt, establish businesses, join a faction, or simply make your own living.

Exploration combines travel across a world map with tile-based regional areas. Long journeys require you to consider your route and the time they will take. Once you enter an area, you can explore its terrain, characters, buildings, and resources tile by tile. Every action consumes time—and may bring new opportunities or unexpected trouble.

When conflict breaks out, the game shifts into turn-based tactical combat. Distance, terrain, obstacles, weapons, injuries, and the actions of your companions can all affect the course of battle. Fighting is not always the only solution. Negotiation, escape, seeking help, or accepting the consequences may also change how events unfold.

Characters are not merely waiting for the player to collect quests from them. They have their own identities, relationships, and loyalties, and will respond to you according to past events, local rumors, and their present circumstances. Prices are also influenced by where goods are produced, available stock, local demand, road conditions, and the wider state of the world.

Growth is about more than increasing numerical attributes. Martial arts, equipment, physical condition, practical skills, personal relationships, and the businesses you own will all affect the actions available to you. You may devote an entire lifetime to mastering martial arts, earning a living, managing enterprises, building connections, or exploring the world—and you are always free to change direction.

Canglang Xingjuan aims to present a wuxia world designed for long-term play. Rather than imposing a single goal upon the player, it allows every choice to become a reason to continue the journey.

Features

  • Exploration combining a world map with tile-based regional areas.

  • Turn-based tactical combat built around terrain, distance, obstacles, and injuries.

  • Character progression through martial arts, equipment, physical condition, and practical skills.

  • Livelihood systems including trade, gathering, construction, business management, and escort work.

  • Character interactions shaped by relationships, identity, rumors, and the consequences of your actions.

  • A wuxia life with no fixed classes and no single path to completion.

The money never sleeps

You start with limited cash, a debt to repay and a deadline. Capital Criminal is a retro economic strategy and management game played through an interface: read the market, make deals and decide how much of your future to put at risk. Your ambition is an underworld empire. Every decision has a cost.

Buy low. Travel. Sell high.

Trade illicit goods across 12 international cities. Compare prices, buyers and available supply, then decide what to carry and where to sell. Travel consumes time and money, so a high selling price is only part of the calculation.

Every profit has a price

Keep cash for the next journey. Manage bank deposits and debt while police encounters, rival gangs and unexpected events threaten your plans. Health and morale matter alongside the balance sheet.

Reinvest. Expand. Take control.

The longer careers open new ways to invest your earnings. Build warehouses and sales points in the 90-day and 365-day modes. The 365-day career adds laboratories, production and deeper asset progression. Sales points can generate income as game days advance; expansion still demands decisions and carries risk.

Build your fortune before time runs out

Follow your financial history, compare results and try a different route next time. Growth is your goal, and neither profit nor survival is guaranteed.

  • 30 days: a focused trading, debt and survival challenge, without investments.

  • 90 days: trade and expand with the mode's limited investment options.

  • 365 days: develop a broader operation with production and advanced assets.

Try the free demo

Play a complete, replayable 30-day career in the free Windows demo. Use the demo button on this page, then add Capital Criminal to your wishlist to follow the full game's release.

More color, personality and atmosphere

Choose refined palettes and the new Lime, Cyber Pop and Tropical Neon themes, with clearer product highlights and financial indicators.

Your little partner in crime now sports sunglasses, a gold chain, expressive gestures and a persistent mood. He reacts to deals, travel and your financial situation while looking for free spaces in the interface.

Overnight scenes feature a layered skyline, stars and four weather conditions. During air travel, the departure city fades into the destination as the plane crosses the screen. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.

One night an earthquake shook Hoshizora Capsule Hall. The machines went dark and thousands of capsules rolled across the floor. Pick up a capsule, crack it open, find the figure's display case — and watch its row of machines light up in neon again.

Open, sort, light it up

Every capsule is a little surprise: common figures, shiny rares and one golden secret in every series. New figures go on display. Duplicates go into the bins or onto the Swap Board to trade for the ones you're still missing, and empty shells pour into the chutes for tokens.

Six floors and a secret roof

Complete every case to celebrate a Grand Reopening, then climb the stairs. Each floor has its own look, music and figure series:

  • 1F · Capsule Hall

  • 2F · Sweet & Sushi Corner

  • 3F · Matsuri Night

  • 4F · Aquarium Deck

  • 5F · Forest Shrine

And above them all waits a secret rooftop garden for the golden figures you find.

Tidy at your own pace

Spend tokens in the Token Shop on abilities and upgrade them: Capsule Radar highlights a series, Gather Series pulls its capsules into one pile, Carry Bag holds more shells and Auto-Place sends a figure straight to its slot. Relax in Zen mode with no counters on screen, or chase your best floor times in Speed mode.

  • Around 3,400 capsules across 6 themed floors and a secret rooftop garden

  • Duplicates are never wasted: bins, shell chutes and a Swap Board

  • 4 abilities, each with upgrades

  • Zen and Speed play styles, 3 save slots

  • No fail states — clean up at your own pace

Captive 3000 is an old-school dungeon crawler in the style of Dungeon Master, Legend of Grimrock, Eye of the Beholder, Black Crypt and Hired Guns, with a dystopian science-fiction setting.

Inspired by the 1990 Amiga / Atari ST classic Captive, with tile-based movement, real-time combat, resource management, maze exploration, and handcrafted levels, rendered in first-person view using traditional sprites.

Condemned to 1000 years in cryosleep...

You wake on a forgotten moon orbiting an unfamiliar singularity…

Memory wiped... cryogenic chamber smashed….

Alien shadows haunt the abandoned station…

Main power failing, an emergency console flickers to life… the alarm repeats…

EARTH HAS FALLEN...

The terminal reaches out to a decommissioned Optimus Mark I on a distant planet…

A glimmer of hope?

Guide the ancient automaton through the vast expanse... find your lonely prison…

And stage your own rescue...

But your identity, the tale of your incarceration, and the fate of humanity…

... is yet unknown ...

DESIGN

Many modern first-person dungeon crawlers use 3D engines to emulate the traditional sprite-based grid/tile movement used by the original 'blobber' games like Dungeon Master. As a result they often experience sluggish, slow movement.

Captive 3000 is built the old way, using traditional sprites (no 3D engines) and is lightning fast.

The game features 13 handcrafted levels with multiple floors per level. These 13 Levels form Mission 01.

Illustrated story chapters are hidden across the levels. Each mural reveals a fragment of the truth.

Explore every corridor. Search every corner. The story is gradually revealed as your memory returns, and you discover your true identity and the fate of humanity,

The first few levels of Mission 01 are small and introduce players gradually to the game mechanics.

Each level is larger than the last, with the final levels being vast and complex, taking several hours each to complete.

Finishing the entire first mission of 13 levels involves more than 50 hours of exploration and combat.

After that, the system generates infinite new and unique missions (sets of 13 levels) so you can continue playing Captive 3000 forever. In 'endless mode' the level generation is deterministic and seed-based (not random) so each unique level always looks and plays consistently for all players. 

Players won't max out their stats and equipment by the end of Mission 01, so there is something new to discover in later missions. You can also go back and replay a completed mission or level any time.

GAMEPLAY

Gameplay is fast. Shooting and stepping is instant. You'll need quick reactions to dodge enemy attacks and projectiles. Monsters get stronger and faster as the levels progress. It's usually best to attack enemies from behind or from the side, while they're turning, and then step out of range or behind cover, rather than trying to tank them.

Your early ranged and melee weapons are slow and weak, but soon you'll be zipping around the levels firing rapid lasers, ion pulse weapons, flamers and more. You'll need to watch your shield, health, and energy levels. Movement and action drain your droid's energy, and resource management is important.

You'll find power-ups hidden in cupboards, lying on the ground, or available to buy from merchants. You can also spend experience points to gain new skills and abilities to suit your play style.

The game features some roguelite elements. To save your progress, you must find blockchain fragments, which are well hidden. One enemy is immortal, and must be avoided. He moves slowly but if you run into him while your shield is down, it means instant death. Certain tiles are safe, and you can trap him with skill, taking him out of action for the rest of the level, and adding a strategic element to the gameplay. The minimap and radar will help you track his location. Keeping your shield charged is a priority, and certain power-ups also keep him at bay.

Running out of energy is always a risk. Getting lost in a distant part of the base, far from a recharge station... do you press on, hoping to find a new one, or backtrack and hope to reach the prior one before your power runs out?

If a section seems difficult, you can often use ladders and pits to traverse above or below harder zones, emerging on the other side in a distant part of the level. Exploring the connections between floors is an essential part of navigation.

CLOSING COMMENTS

The original 1990 Captive was my favorite childhood game. Created by Antony Crowther, inspired by Dungeon Master, and published by the now defunct Mindscape, it was decades ahead of its time, with infinite procedurally generated missions and a unique sci-fi setting. Captive 3000 continues what Tony Crowther started. I hope you enjoy it!

DISCLAIMER: Captive 3000 is inspired by the 1990 classic. It is not affiliated with the original and is not a copy or a remake or a sequel. It is built from scratch, and does not copy or reuse any code, art, music, or level designs from the original. It is a completely new and independent "Dungeon Master in Space" project. The complex logistics and inventory management of the original Captive are deliberately not included. Captive 3000 plays more like a fast-paced action-RPG roguelite, with a focus on exploration and combat. The streamlined design allows the game to be fully controlled using gamepads or touchscreen devices (not just keyboard and mouse).

Climb the tower. Survive the horde. Become a god.

Capy of Gods is an action roguelike about a capybara climbing a colossal tower while waves of enemies try to drag it back down. It blends vertical platforming with automatic bullet heaven combat: you focus on climbing and dodging, your weapons fire on their own.

Every run is different. Every floor is fresh chaos.

⚔️ Fight as you climb
Your weapons attack automatically: you decide where to move, when to jump, and when to dash to dodge. Gain XP, level up, and pick from 3 upgrades: new weapons, animal instincts, and synergies that reshape your entire build.

🗼 A tower that builds itself
Platforms, traps, chests, secret rooms and biomes, all procedurally generated every run. Climb The Tower, cross The Labyrinth and reach The Summit across 6 biomes. You never climb the same tower twice.

👹 Bosses and semi-bosses
More than 20 bosses, from flying semi-bosses with unique attack patterns to floor bosses you summon when you're ready. Survive the horde… and whatever the horde is hiding.

💎 Persistent progression
Earn rubies every run and unlock permanent attributes, weapons, instincts, items, and new capybara characters, each with its own playstyle.

🎮 Easy to pick up, hard to put down
Simple controls, fast runs, deep decisions. Full keyboard and controller support.

🌍 Available in 29 languages
English, Español (España), Español (Latinoamérica), Français, Italiano, Deutsch, Nederlands, Dansk, Svenska, Norsk, Suomi, Português (Brasil), Português (Portugal), Polski, Čeština, Magyar, Română, Türkçe, Русский, Українська, Български, Ελληνικά, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Tiếng Việt, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어

How high will you climb before the tower swallows you whole?

These Capybaras are armed to the teeth and eager to unleash destruction on both their enemies and the environment, with a huge arsenal of fun but deadly weapons. Blow it all up online, alone or in local multiplayer in turn-based combat.

Experience full destruction as in classical 2D artillery games, but in a modern 3D version, with a huge arsenal of both realistic and optional goofy weapons. Using a unique combination of multiple destruction systems, this game makes artillery, grenades and rockets deform the terrain as well as everything on top of it, opening for new tactics and exciting gameplay.

More chaos means more views! Crash. Record. Share. Create the next viral video!

Lead your nation through the Wars of Religion of the 17th century.

Caracol is a historical grand strategy game with the heart of a wargame. Guide your nation through dynastic rivalries, religious tensions, and major conflicts, from the War of the Jülich Succession to the Defenestration of Prague and the Peace of the Pyrenees.
Manage your finances, cultivate diplomatic relations, and wage military campaigns where preparation, logistics, and leadership can determine the fate of entire nations.


War Doesn't Wait for Your Turn
In Caracol, all factions' orders are resolved simultaneously through the strategic WeGo system. While your armies advance, enemy forces are on the move as well: everyone moves, fights, and retreats during the same resolution phase.
Anticipate enemy maneuvers, coordinate your forces, and prepare for the unexpected. Reacting isn't enough: you must predict.


The Art of Command
Build armies of pikemen, musketeers, cuirassiers, and artillery, alongside distinctive national units such as the Swedish Hakkapeliitta and Polish Lisowczycy.
Place your armies under the command of historical figures such as Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden, Albrecht von Wallenstein, and the Count of Tilly.
In battle, units act according to their characteristics, positioning, and initiative. Like a general of the period, you won't directly control every unit, but you can intervene at critical moments by adjusting your tactical deployment, committing reserves, ordering a Push of Pikes, or calling for a retreat.

Victory is prepared before the battle begins.


Wars Are Won Through Logistics
Recruiting a large army is not enough. To wage a successful campaign, you must organize and protect your land and naval supply lines, ensuring your forces can continue fighting even far from their bases.
Besiege enemy fortresses and use artillery to weaken their defenses: choose between a prolonged war of attrition and a risky assault.


To Govern Is to Choose
War demands money, manpower, and political stability.
Manage your nation's fiscal and monetary policies, confront inflation, and take out loans to finance your campaigns. Enact edicts to develop your state and strengthen its power.

What strengthens your army today may weaken your nation tomorrow.


Faith and Power
The 17th century was an age of intense political and religious fanaticism. As a ruler, your task is to satisfy the demands of the noble and religious elites while taking care not to oppress your population too severely.
Zeal measures this delicate balance, influencing your ability to attract investment and recruit generals while also carrying the risk of sparking revolts across your provinces.


History Has Yet to Be Written
Explore a historical map featuring over 300 provinces, stretching from North Africa to Scandinavia and from Western Europe to Silesia.
Encounter over 180 historical commanders and experience more than 100 interactive events inspired by the great conflicts, dynastic rivalries, and religious tensions of the 17th century.

History has already been written. In your hands, its outcome may be different.

Keep the wheels turning.

Caravan Survivors is an auto-battler crossed with an arcade scroller. Your caravan rolls down a deadly road while hired heroes and mounted turrets hold back the endless horde. Build your loadout, upgrade your caravan, hire heroes, manage your caravan's inventory, and haul risky cargo for profit. Survive the route at all cost.

Build your loadout on a grid
Everything that matters lives in your caravans grid inventory. Turrets, relics, hero beds, and cargo crates all take up space, and space is tight. What you fit determines which weapons fire, which fighters deploy, and how much gold you're hauling. Owning an item isn't enough, your chassis limits how much you can run at once, so every item is a trade-off.

Level up on luck
Killing enemies earns XP, and leveling up pauses the run to offer a choice of upgrades. Each one rolls a rarity: the luckier the roll, the stronger the buff, and upgrades stack as you pick them. Your build compounds over a route, then resets when you head back to town for the next contract.

Take the contract, run the risk
Between runs you return to the Town hub: buy and sell in the shop, upgrade your caravan, expand your chassis, and pick your next contract. Tougher contracts pay more but stack the odds against you: deadlier enemies, denser hordes, road hazards. Rare cargo raises the stakes further attracting even more enemies to your caravan.

Features

  • Auto-battling heroes with distinct classes and abilities

  • Grid-based, drag-and-drop loadout management

  • Find relics and place them in your inventory to modify nearby items with various effects

  • Luck-driven, temporary stacking level-up upgrades with a four-tier rarity system

  • Turrets across multiple archetypes: straight shooters, streams of frost, mortars, and more

  • Elemental damage and status effects: fire, ice, lightning, bleed

  • A Town economy of contracts, shops, licenses, and permanent upgrades

  • Risk-reward rare cargo that attracts enemies or curses your caravan

  • Route bosses, tougher enemies, and escalating road hazards that add modifiers to your runs

  • Full gamepad and Steam Deck support planned

Card Duel: Black Rite is a card game where poker hands decide duels. Face enemies across an eerie table, making critical decisions each hand with limited items and health.

• Use magic cards to reshape the game, turning poker hands into weapons

• At showdown, the strength of your hand decides life or death

• Choose Fate events and let fate lead you to vastly different outcomes

• Spend Sanity to use contracts for powerful card effects that turn the tide

• Face enemies with unique mechanics and distinct personalities

• Between encounters, visit the counter to buy items and heal your wounds

• Play with friends in 2–4-player multiplayer matches

• Become the ultimate winner of the duel

Card Slay is a poker roguelike deckbuilder where the House fights back.

Fight through a cursed House with poker hands as your weapons. Red suits deal damage. Black suits build Block. Shape your deck around powerful combos, then choose the hand that keeps you alive.





Draw eight cards and build a poker hand using one to five cards. You have limited plays and discards each turn, so read the enemy’s next move before you commit. Chase a red Flush for a crushing hit, hold black cards to weather an attack, or mix colors to do both. Preview your hand’s Attack and Block before you play.



  • An in-game hand guide helps you learn the poker patterns as you play.



The monsters attack your deck as well as your health. The Grave Auditor slips cursed cards into your draw pile. The Crystal Grub shrugs off small hits until one powerful attack cracks its shell and stuns it. Elites and bosses impose rules that can punish repeated hands or limit your discards. Read their intentions, find the opening, and make your next hand count.





Draft new cards, forge upgrades, and remove cards that get in your way. Collect Runes whose passive effects combine throughout the run, and save single-use Phials to turn a desperate fight around. Build toward the hands you want to draw, then watch an ordinary card become the heart of your combo.



  • Level up your favorite poker hands so even a Pair can pack a punch.
  • Choose your route through battles, elites, merchants, rest sites, and events that can help or hurt your run.



Begin with the Ashen Deck and unlock seven more ways to challenge the House. The Forge Deck favors aggressive play with red cards. The Bastion Deck turns defense into damage. The Star Deck rewards varied hands and gives you tools to read upcoming draws. Each deck brings a different starting build to master.





Cards are ancient magic, and the House’s attempt to control fate has trapped its inhabitants in a curse. Fight through three acts and uncover their story, run by run. Unlock The Last Deal beyond the Aether Core, face the First Dealer, and discover three endings to the House’s unfinished hand.

ALSO IN THE HOUSE


  • Track discoveries, lore, and achievements in the House Collection.
  • Full controller support.
  • English, Français, Italiano, Deutsch, Español, 简体中文, 日本語, Русский.

Every hand is a weapon. Every suit is a choice. Every run is another attempt to break the House.

Game Keywords: Single-player / Cartoon Ink-Wash Fusion Style / Roguelike / Martial Arts / Card Game

Rooted in traditional martial arts concepts and core card game logic, this game features a unique offensive and defensive system. You will play as a martial artist roaming the martial arts world, gaining experience in randomly generated levels, using cards to attack, block, counter, and seize enemy flaws, defeating foes through martial arts, and forging your own path with every challenge.

Core Game Content & Features

Martial Arts Card Combat System

Moves include basic and derivative types—derivatives enhance basics, which deal damage and create flaws. Seizing enemy flaws triggers high-damage chain attacks; every round is a tactical battle of move and countermove.

Roguelike Random Dungeon Crawl

Each difficulty has a set number of battles, with customizable challenge order. Choose from multiple rewards after each victory. The game includes permadeath—adventure progress resets on death, ensuring unique playthroughs every time.

In-Run Progression

Move damage scales with character attributes. Win battles to gain attribute upgrades, boosting damage and flaw-creating ability. Use attribute points to increase max health and flaw capacity.

CardAndDungeon is a roguelike deckbuilding RPG that combines first-person, grid-based dungeon exploration with party-based card combat. Assemble a party of three heroes and face new dangers and rewards on every procedurally generated expedition.

Your Party Is Your Deck


Each hero brings unique cards and a distinct combat role. Your party composition defines your starting deck and available strategies, allowing you to combine different classes into a deck engine of your own.

When a hero falls, their cards lose their normal effects and become Soul Binding actions. Keep fighting to bind your companion's soul back to their body—but those who return from death carry lasting Soul Trauma.

Explore Dangerous Dungeons


Navigate grid-based dungeons from a first-person perspective and discover monsters, treasure chests, traps, shrines, ruins, shops, and other encounters. Choose your route, manage gold, keys, and disarm tools, and descend toward more dangerous floors.

Dungeon layouts, encounters, and rewards change between expeditions. Take the safer path or risk your party for greater rewards.

Master Turn-Based Card Combat


Read enemy intents and targets, then make the most of your limited AP. Combine Attack, Defense, Control, and Party cards with each hero's abilities to overcome your enemies.

Acquire new cards, upgrade existing ones, and refine your deck during the expedition. Relics and Blessings create new possibilities, while Curses and Soul Trauma make the journey increasingly dangerous.

Survive the Soulwell


Your party composition, card rewards, Relics, Curses, and exploration choices persist throughout the run. If the entire party falls, the expedition ends. Adapt your deck, preserve your resources, and brave the ever-changing depths of the Soulwell.
